sentences.text: This northern elephant seal was tracked for {days_tracked}, from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Northern elephant seals make two long feeding trips a year, coming ashore in between to breed and to moult.
This seal went as far north as {northernmost_lat}, and on {farthest_date} it was {max_displacement_km} from where its track began.
Its daily positions add up to {path_km} in all.
What it did after the tag stopped isn't recorded.
